title: Creation SMP
description: A server ursing the Creation modpack
body:
### Blaze Develepment prezents: Creation SMP

An SMP were you can build whatever you want on a world with PvP.
You only get **one** claim chunk use it wisely...

There are no limitations in this server exept the folowing things
- Hacking
- Exploiting
- Duping
- Intentional lag machines
